title: Timetable
subtitle: View each classroom's weekly timetable; supports adding, moving, and deleting sessions.

picker.title: Classroom timetable (pick a slot)
picker.hint: Check cells one by one: adjacent cells automatically form one session; clicking a non-adjacent cell restarts the selection there; click a checked cell again to uncheck it. Press Apply to backfill the form. The session being moved counts as free (its merged block checks as a whole); other occupied cells (sessions and bookings) are not selectable. Switching classrooms or paging weeks clears the selection.

form.periodEnd: End period (last period for multi-period sessions; leave blank for single)

validation.periodRange: Invalid period range: start must be ≥ 1 and not greater than end
